target_invariant: Redis remains primary for workflow/runtime entities until each PG_READ entity is explicitly enabled after readiness evidence; onlyInRedis is a cutover blocker, while onlyInPG rows must be classified by retention policy before cleanup or PG_READ rollout.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: pg-verify separates PG-primary agent presence from Redis-managed agent definitions
acceptance_coverage.notes: Konoha bus presence is PostgreSQL-primary; managed agent definitions and AGENTS.md lifecycle remain Redis/managed-definition projections.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: PG-only rows are classified by retention class and safe cleanup disposition before action
acceptance_coverage.notes: Retention report is read-only, groups PG-only rows, blocks cleanup when onlyInRedis exists, and separates safe candidates from manual-review rows.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: PG_READ readiness report preserves onlyInRedis and PG-only retention blockers
acceptance_coverage.notes: Readiness returns ready/blocked/pg_primary per entity and marks rollout unsafe when enabled entities are blocked.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: PG_READ rollout uses conservative default-off entity flags instead of one global switch
acceptance_coverage.notes: PG_READ_ENTITIES and per-entity PG_READ_* flags gate Redis-primary reads one entity at a time; legacy PG_READ=true remains an explicit fallback.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: high-volume runtime retention keeps active artifacts visible and blocks cleanup/compaction on Redis-only or active effect state
acceptance_coverage.notes: Active cases use active retention classes before high-volume completed classes; archive/compaction requires PG shadow consistency and no Redis-only rows.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: existing onlyInRedis cases, work_items, or workflows remain explicit blockers rather than false green readiness
acceptance_coverage.notes: PG_READ readiness and retention cleanup both hard-block on onlyInRedis; onlyInPG bloat is retention debt until classified and approved.

requires: safe cleanup candidate or manual review disposition

review_commands: PATH=/home/ubuntu/.bun/bin:$PATH bun test --timeout 30000 tests/pg-read-consistency-closure-report.test.ts tests/pg-verify-agent-contract.test.ts tests/pg-only-retention-report.test.ts tests/pg-read-readiness-report.test.ts tests/pg-read-flags.test.ts tests/runtime-retention-policy.test.ts tests/runtime-retention-cleanup.test.ts

closure_decision.notes: This reconciles the #683 parent after #737, #738, #739, #740, and #754. Production release still follows the #686 checklist and #812 terminal-case gate; PG_READ cutover remains entity-scoped and gated by live readiness evidence.
